newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH 13-WK T-BILL YIELD DIPS TO 11.6 PCT (12 PCT).
newsitem.headline: CZECH 13-WK T-BILL YIELD DIPS TO 11.6 PCT (12 PCT).

text.p: Gross yield in an auction of a five billion crown tranche of Czech Finance Ministry 13-week T-bills eased to 11.60 percent from 12 percent in the last auction of similar bills on March 10, the central bank said on Thursday.
The central bank added in a statement that market bids totalled 10.525 billion crowns, with the central bank itself taking three billion crowns worth of T-bills.
A total of 4.999 billion in market bids were accepted, it added.
Net yield of the T-bills was 8.7 percent.
